title: Upgrade React Native 0.73 → 0.74: enable the New Architecture
prompt: This project upgraded to React Native 0.74 but still runs with the old architecture flag off (`newArchEnabled=false`), so it cannot use the new-arch-only APIs and the upgrade's native module integration fails. Fix android/gradle.properties to enable the New Architecture (`newArchEnabled=true`) and pin the React Native architecture to the arm64-v8a, x86, x86_64 targets (`reactNativeArchitectures=armeabi-v7a,arm64-v8a,x86,x86_64`). Return each changed file with its complete new content.

export const APP_NAME = 'rn-bench-app';
export const APP_VERSION = '1.0.0';
